note: MOD_PLAN.md section 6 item 4: STRATA_DMA_FLAG_WRITE (flag B written by the copy stream, hipStreamWriteValue32) and STRATA_PCIE_FORK (flag-B wait + PCIe groups on a forked stream) act only with a PCIe share, so the base is --pcie-frac 0.15 (spec 54's value). Lossy only against the preset arm (CPU vs GPU rows); the three switch arms are EXACT against pcie015 (same text required). The preset arm (pcie-frac 0) is the reference that decides whether a share with the fast flag path beats no share. Stop pancake.service first.
